text: A prince ought to live amongst his people in such a way that no unexpected circumstances, whether of good or evil, shall make him change; because if the necessity for this comes in troubled times, you are too late for harsh measures; and mild ones will not help you, for they will be considered as forced from you, and no one will be under any obligation to you for them.
author: Niccolo Machiavelli
locator: Chapter VIII, Concerning those who have obtained a principality by wickedness
location: Sant'Andrea in Percussina, near Florence, Italy
